description: This file defines the 'PhaseList' React component, which renders a list of items with inline editing capabilities for each item's title, description, and status. It includes sub-component 'Row' for individual item rendering, managing editing state and handlers for updating and deleting items.

methods.name: PhaseList({ items, onUpdate, onDelete })
methods.description: Main component rendering a list of phase items with inline editing support.

methods.name: Row({ item, onUpdate, onDelete })
methods.description: Sub-component rendering a single item with editing controls, managing its own editing state.
